canonicalHashRule: SHA-256 of compact body JSON with trailing newline removed; draftByteCount records the submitted pretty draft

mechanics.binding: a player wins by completing a straight connection of exactly three; gravity is false

pace.binding: at most nine placements before board fill; submitted terminal replay ends after five legal placements

context.binding: no hidden information, network state, or required external material

input.binding: current seat places one unoccupied primary cell in 0...8; occupied cells and out-of-range cells are illegal

deterministicRule.terminalRule: first straight line of connectionLength three, otherwise board-full draw

uiFastGate.coreInteraction: 3x3 board and rematch control remain in the lower half

carrier.binding: bounded vote-action game with private role projection

mechanics.binding: each seat privately receives a role projection and casts one ballot to infer and remove the rival team

pace.binding: maximumRounds is one and each seat submits at most one vote

context.binding: pass-and-play secrecy is local; no network or external material is required

input.binding: each active seat votes once for the other active seat; self-votes, duplicate votes, and out-of-range seats are illegal

deterministicRule.terminalRule: after both legal votes in the one-round ballot, deterministic majority elimination resolves the winner

uiFastGate.coreInteraction: role reveal and single lower-half vote targets are at least 44pt

carrier.binding: bounded stroke canvas plus prompt-choice guessing

mechanics.binding: rotating drawer matches a private word prompt to a bounded sketch; the other seat selects a prompt

pace.binding: four rounds and at most eight strokes per round bound the complete session

context.binding: local pass-and-play drawing and guessing; no network or external material is required

input.binding: drawer submits bounded stroke points, then the other seat selects one prompt index 0...7; actions alternate for four rounds

deterministicRule.terminalRule: after four legal stroke/guess rounds, deterministic prompt scoring resolves the winner

uiFastGate.coreInteraction: drawing surface and guess targets occupy the lower-half thumb zone
